title_sq: Tek Sheshi Willson Shitet Apartament 2+1 I Bollshem!!
description_sq: Tek Shkolla Deshmoret e Lirise shitet apartament 2+1 i bollshem . Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin 8 jo te fundit te nje pallati te ri te mireadministruar me ashensor. Apartamenti eshte i organizuar ne korridorin hyres qe ben shperndarjen ne sallonin e ndenjes, bashke me ambientin e gatimit dhe te ngrenies dhe me dalje ne ballkon, dy dhoma gjumi, dhe nje tualet. Orientimi i apartamentit eshte jug-lindje, cka e ben qe te kete drite natyrale ne pjesen me te madhe te dites. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet apartamenti ofron nje shumellojshmeri facilitetesh per nje jetese sa me komode. Gjithashtu eshte nje opsion shume i mire dhe per investim duke patur parasysh qirate ne zone. Prona disponon dokumentacion te plote hipotekor.
title_en: Spacious 2+1 apartment for sale in Willson Square!!
description_en: A spacious 2+1 apartment is for sale at the Martyrs of Freedom School. The apartment is located on the 8th floor, not the last, of a new, well-managed building with an elevator. The apartment is organized in the entrance corridor that divides into the living room, together with the cooking and dining area and exit to the balcony, two bedrooms and a bathroom. The orientation of the apartment is south-east, which means that there is natural light during most of the day. The area in which the apartment is located offers a variety of facilities for a more comfortable life. It is also a very good option for investment considering the rents in the area. The property has full mortgage documentation.
